senses.def: Synonym of I kid you not (Used to insist that one is telling the truth)
A province of the Cordillera Administrative Region, Luzon, Philippines. Capital: Lagawe, created from the partitioning of the historical Mountain Province.
ex: Meronyms: Aguinaldo, Alfonso Lista, Asipulo, Banaue, Hingyon, Hungduan, Kiangan, Lagawe, Lamut, Mayoyao, Tinoc — municipalities of Ifugao

senses.def: Ifugao (a subprovince of Mountain Province, Luzon, Philippines).
A Malayo-Polynesian language spoken in the northern valleys of Ifugao in the Philippines.
